The American singer-songwriter Taylor Swift has received numerous industry awards and honorary accolades. She is the most-awarded artist of the American Music Awards (40), [ 1 ] the Billboard Music Awards (49), [ 2 ] the MTV Video Music Awards (30), [ 3 ] and the iHeartRadio Music Awards (41). [ 4 ] [ 5 ] She has the most Album of the Year wins at the Grammy Awards (4) [ 6 ] and the most Video of the Year wins

iHeartRadio Music Awards (41). [ 4 ] [ 5 ] She has the most Album of the Year wins at the Grammy Awards (4) [ 6 ] and the most Video of the Year wins at the MTV Video Music Awards (5), [ 7 ] and she has been recognized as the Global Recording Artist of the Year by the International Federation of the Phonographic Industry more times than any other artist (6). [ 8 ] Swift began her career in country music . [ 9 ] She was nominated for Best New Artist at the 50th Annual Grammy Awards in 2008. [ 10 ] Her second studio album, Fearless (2008), won Album of the Year at the Country Music Association Awards , Academy of Country Music Awards , and Grammy Awards; it further won the Grammy Award for Best Country Album . [ 11 ] Her singles " White Horse " (2008) and " Mean " (2010) both won the Grammy Award for Best Country Song ; the former also won Best Female Country Vocal Performance , and the latter Best Country Solo Performance . [ 12 ] [ 13 ] Her soundtrack single " Safe & Sound " for The Hunger Games (2011) won the Grammy Award for Best Song Written for Visual Media . [ 14 ] Swift transitioned from country to pop stardom with her fifth studio album, 1989 (2014), [ 15 ] which won Album of the Year and Best Pop Vocal Album at the 58th Annual Grammy Awards in 2016, where the music video for its single " Bad Blood " won Best Music Video . [ 16 ] At the 2016 BMI Pop Awards , Swift was honored with the Taylor Swift Award, becoming the second artist after Michael Jackson to have an award named after its recipient. [ 17 ] In 2019, Swift was honored as the Woman of the Decade by Billboard [ 18 ] and the Artist of the Decade at the American Music Awards . Folklore (2020), won Album of the Year at the 63rd Annual Grammy Awards in 2021. [ 20 ] She became the first woman honored with the Global Icon Award at the Brit Awards , in 2021 . [ 21 ] In 2023, Swift became the first entertainer to be honored as Time ' s Person of the Year . [ 22 ] She achieved her fourth Grammy Award for Album of the Year with her tenth studio album, Midnights (2022), which also won Best Pop Vocal Album, at the 66th Annual Grammy Awards in 2024. [ 6 ] The Grammy nomination for Song of the Year of " Anti-Hero " made her the first songwriter to have seven nominations in this category. [ 23 ] Swift's eleventh album, The Tortured Poets Department (2024), made her the first woman to earn seven Album of the Year nominations at the Grammys. [ 24 ] In January 2025, she was named the Top Artist of the 21st Century by Billboard . [ 25 ] In 2026, she was inducted into the Songwriters Hall of Fame .
